jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
jobs.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

🎯 The Role — Principal Information Security & Data Protection Officer

Working closely with Commercial, Engineering, Product and Legal to lead Unmind's Information Security and Data Protection programmes and act as Unmind's designated Data Protection Officer (DPO). We process health information at scale, so trust is central to what we offer. We're looking for a hands-on, senior individual contributor who can own both disciplines end to end and give the business clear, practical advice.

This role sets security and privacy requirements, advises and assures.

Overall responsibility for;

Information Security

  • the management of Information Security within the business;

  • maintaining ISO 27001:2022 and Cyber Essentials certification, chairing the ISMS Board and running the ISMS day to day – policies, risk management, controls, evidence and internal audits;

  • liaising with Engineering, Product and Data & AI on information security threats and vulnerabilities and recommending mitigations;

  • Information Security incident management and remediation;

  • managing the Application and Infrastructure penetration testing and vulnerability management process, tracking findings to closure;

  • leading AI governance operations, including the AI policy and register, AI use-case risk reviews and readiness for ISO 42001;

  • managing the Information Security pre-sales, RFP and contractual process, and keeping trust materials in Conveyor current;

  • managing the business's security education and awareness training programme;

  • reporting information security compliance and risk to ELT and the Board.

Data Protection Officer

  • performing the statutory duties of the DPO under UK and EU GDPR, including acting as the contact point for the ICO and other data protection authorities;

  • maintaining Unmind's privacy framework, including privacy notices and retention;

  • advising on privacy for new products, suppliers and AI use cases, including coordinating DPIAs;

  • managing data subject rights requests and personal data breach assessments;

  • leading privacy review of DPAs and client assurance with Legal and Commercial, and reporting data protection risk to ELT and the Board.

🌟 About You

We know great people come from all sorts of backgrounds, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what really matters. We welcome applications from people with different experiences and perspectives, while recognising that certain qualifications are essential for this role. You’ll find these outlined below.

ESSENTIAL:

  • Experience of implementing and maintaining ISO 27001 certification within a global technology business;

  • Expert practical knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, including DPIAs, rights requests, personal data breaches, and international transfers;

  • Experience acting as, or working closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer;

  • Confident client-facing presence, able to explain Unmind's data security and privacy approach clearly to prospective and existing clients;

  • Experience advising engineering and product teams on mitigation solutions for application and infrastructure security risks;

  • Sound understanding of AI-related security and privacy risks;

  • Ability to give clear, independent advice and challenge to senior leaders;

  • Commitment and attention to detail;

  • Able to manage multiple competing requests across the business, prioritising by risk and deadline;

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Credible and behaves with the highest levels of integrity.

DESIRED:

  • Experience with health or other special category data, or digital wellbeing products;

  • Experience in a high growth business environment;

  • Familiarity with ISO 27701 and ISO 42001;

  • A recognised security or privacy certification (such as CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E or CIPM), or equivalent practical experience.

A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen.

jobs.description:

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

 

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

 

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.   
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

  • Contribute to software architecture and design decisions 

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates 

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams 

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

  • Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems 

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

 

What you get  
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values 
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
 
Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. 
 
We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. 
 
Apply 
Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you!

jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

 

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

 

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

 

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

 

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

 

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

·       Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

·       Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

·       Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools;

·       Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market;

·       Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes;

·       Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey;

·       Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities;

·       Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business;

·       Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working.


Who you are

You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and building trusted relationships with hiring managers.

You are proactive, curious and not afraid to challenge the business when you believe there is a better way to attract or select talent.

 

For this role, we are looking for someone who:

·       Has 3–5 years of experience in corporate recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within a product, technology or international organization;

·       Has experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to selection and offer;

·       Is confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and proactive sourcing techniques;

·       Has experience working closely with hiring managers and other business stakeholders;

·       Understands the importance of candidate experience and employer branding;

·       Is independent, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic environment;

·       Has a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys making recruitment processes better;

·       Communicates fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken;

·       Lives within reasonable commuting distance of De Lier, the Netherlands.


What you get   
In numbers 

·       A monthly salary between €3.600,00 - €5.100,00 based on your experience; 

·       We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

·       8% holiday allowance; 

·       Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

·       Be secured with our pension plan; 

·       Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

·       Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

·       Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

 

Ready to help us find the people behind our future?

If recruitment is more than filling vacancies to you, and you enjoy combining sourcing, stakeholder management and candidate experience, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and discover how you can help us create a climate for growth.

Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
jobs.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

  • Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

  • You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

  • You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week  

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

  • A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

  • Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

  • Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

  • A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you

jobs.description:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

jobs.title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
jobs.description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.

  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.

  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.

  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.

  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.

  • Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.

  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.

  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.

  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.

  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.

  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.

  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.

  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.


Candidature

Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis.

jobs.title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
About Singular Photonics:

Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution.

About the Role:

We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host.

Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment.

You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams.
  • RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control.
  • Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware.
  • Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado.
  • High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link.
  • Bring-Up & Debug: Lead firmware bring-up on new boards and sensors, debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and in-system probes.
  • Source Control & Build: Keep RTL under version control with a repeatable, automated build, and document designs to the standard our ISO 9001 design control process requires.
  • Reviews & Support: Contribute to design reviews, and support the software team and customers during field integration.

Experience & Skills:

Essential:

  • Strong proficiency in Verilog, and a solid grounding in RTL design, synthesis and timing closure.
  • Hands-on experience with AMD-Xilinx Vivado and its toolchain.
  • Experience writing your own testbenches and verifying a design in simulation before hardware.
  • Experience bringing up firmware on real hardware and debugging it in the lab.
  • Experience with at least one high-speed interface or bus at RTL level.
  • Comfortable in a small company where priorities shift and everyone pitches in.
  • Working with complex, existing codebases and seamlessly integrating new functionality with minimal disruption.

Desirable:

  • SystemVerilog, and verification practices beyond directed testbenches.
  • Comfortable working in Linux operating systems.
  • Exposure to any of PCIe, AXI interface, USB3, Ethernet, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS or Camera Link.
  • C, C++ or Python for embedded software integration and test automation.
  • Experience with image sensors, time-of-flight, TDCs or single-photon detection.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, and reading schematics during debug.

Educational Background:

  • Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2-5 years' experience in FPGA and digital design.

Key Attributes & Behaviours:

  • Rigour: Disciplined about verification - you would rather find it in simulation than on the bench.
  • Debugging: Systematic when the fault could be in the RTL, the board or the sensor, and comfortable with the instruments that tell you which.
  • Clarity: Writes documentation and code that colleagues can pick up without you in the room.
  • Collaboration: Works well across the hardware, ASIC and software boundaries rather than only inside the FPGA.
  • Ownership: Takes a problem from architecture through to a working system, and sees it through.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the requirement can move.

Success Indicators:

  • Firmware that meets timing and functions correctly on first hardware more often than not, with issues found in simulation rather than on the bench.
  • Effective bring-up and debugging support during prototype validation and customer deployment, with hardware and firmware issues resolved promptly.
  • Design documentation, simulation coverage and design review contributions good enough for another engineer to maintain the work.

Benefits of Joining Singular Photonics

At Singular Photonics, we are committed to fostering a rewarding and supportive environment for our team. As an FPGA Firmware Engineer, you will benefit from:

  • Pension: 5% company contribution.
  • Share Options: Participation in the Company EMI Share Option Scheme, so you share in the growth you help build.
  • Enhanced Annual Leave: 35 days paid annual leave per year, inclusive of UK public holidays.
  • Hybrid Working: Primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week (full time worker).
  • Career Growth: Work on silicon and systems few engineers get near, with the chance to shape how we do FPGA development as the team grows.
  • Additional Benefits: [Cycle to work and private medical insurance (once implemented)

Why Join Us

This position offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of SPAD sensor technology, driving innovation and shaping future applications in photonics and imaging. At Singular Photonics you will be part of a passionate, close-knit team, where the work you do is visible in the product and in the hands of customers.

Location & Work Environment

Based at Orchard Brae House, Queensferry Road, Edinburgh. This is a full-time, permanent role. The work is hands-on with hardware in our lab, so it is primarily office-based, with flexibility to work remotely up to two days per week.

Right to work in the UK is essential. We are unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities

Singular Photonics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make appointments on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, please let us know and we will do what we can to accommodate you.

Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. jobs.title: Principal Technical Consultant
jobs.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

As a Professional Services Technical Consultant, you will play a technical role in the architecture and successful installation, integration, and deployment of Identity and Access solutions in our clients' environments. You will also assist our implementation partners in that process. You will report to the Director of Professional Services.

You will:

  • Deliver technical consulting to our customers and partners from various industries including financial services, manufacturing, government, utilities, and more. 
  • Evaluate client business, process, systems, and technology requirements and advise clients on best practices to help guide and solidify proposed designs.
  • Consult with clients to assess current problem states, establish desired future states, and make solution recommendations.
  • Participate in the detailed solution design, implementation, and delivery of Ping Identity IAM product solutions to our clients.
  • Work with customers to install, deploy, and configure Ping Identity solutions to meet the customer's requirements.
  • Collaborate with Ping Internal teams on escalated customer issues requiring deployment expertise. 
  • Participate in services pre-sales processes including presentation of effort size, best practices, and feasibility studies.
  • Develop materials for providing technical consulting (e.g., best practices, report templates, delivery guides, knowledge base articles).
  • Help partners ensure they design an architecture aligned to Ping best practices for a successful customer deployment.
  • Mentor and assist in the development of internal and external technical resources.
  • Lead technical delivery from discovery and design through implementation, testing, production readiness, and handover, coordinating dependencies and surfacing delivery risks early.
  • Design and validate secure, scalable, highly available IAM deployments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including integration, operational, and disaster-recovery considerations.
  • Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues by analysing logs, traces, configurations, and network behaviour; work with Support and Product Engineering to drive resolution where needed.
  • Define and execute technical validation activities, including integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing, and support cutover and go-live planning.
  • Produce clear implementation documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials so customer and partner teams can operate and support the solution after delivery.
  • Balance strong security controls with a seamless user experience when shaping identity journeys and recommendations.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience working in a consulting capacity with a minimum of 2 years working directly in the Identity and Access Management space within a large organization or enterprise
  • Background in a consulting capacity within the Identity and Access Management space, including practical System Integration and Implementation experience 
  • A capability-maturity approach to IAM deployments
  • Comfortable with subjects such as TCP/IP networking, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, and Data Stores
  • Experience with Java/JavaScript/Groovy, HTML/CSS to support web application development
  • Experience in effort estimates and sizing of projects
  • Self-motivated, willing to take initiative, organized, able to work unaccompanied, and manage communications appropriately
  • Bachelor of Science in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Information Systems) or equivalent work-related level of experience
  • Availability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Outstanding cross-functional cooperation skills in particular with our Go-To-Market units.
  • Excellent communication, both verbal and written
  • Practical experience integrating IAM platforms with enterprise directories, applications, APIs, and identity systems, including federation, authentication, and user lifecycle or provisioning flows.
  • Experience with identity standards and protocols such as SCIM, HTTP/REST APIs, and common directory and federation patterns, in addition to OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, FIDO and LDAP.
  • Experience designing or delivering IAM solutions in cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments, including deployment, upgrade, resilience, and operational support considerations.
  • Strong diagnostic skills across application, identity, and network layers, with experience using logs and traces to isolate and resolve integration issues.
  • Experience planning and carrying out technical testing, production cutovers, and transition to customer or partner operations.
  • Ability to facilitate technical discovery and design workshops, explain trade-offs clearly, and adapt recommendations to customer constraints and desired outcomes.
  • Experience working within structured delivery practices, including managing technical risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes across a customer engagement.

You have an advantage if: 

  • Computer and Software Security certifications 
  • ForgeRock or Ping training badges/certifications 
  • Skills with DevOps best practices, including deployment automation tools, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes 
  • Experience with Ping Identity products and architectures, such as PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, PingOne, or PingID.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

About the role

Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up.

You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them.

You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production.

  • Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it.

  • Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight.

  • Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.

  • Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control.

  • Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship.

  • Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it.

  • Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.

 

What you’ll need to have done

  • Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language.

  • Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years.

  • Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end.

  • A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket.

  • Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each.

  • Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy.

  • Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

  • Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back.

 

Helpful, not required

  • Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it.

  • Experience across both backend and frontend.

  • Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your talent partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Manager Interview

  3. Technical Assessment (e.g., code review, system design)

  4. Values Interview

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.
