jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel und Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis.

Das Netzwerk ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird jetzt neu strukturiert. Die Netze werden getrennt und segmentiert, die Produktionsnetze abgesichert, und es entstehen verbindliche Standards. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von LAN, WAN und Backbone an allen Standorten

• Routing und Switching inklusive VLAN-Konzept und Redundanz

• Standortvernetzung per VPN und sichere Remote-Zugänge

• Betrieb der Firewalls (Fortinet) und Neuordnung gewachsener Regelwerke

• Segmentierung der Netze und Trennung von IT und OT, damit die Produktion geschützt läuft

• WLAN und Access Points

• Netzpläne, IP-Adressverwaltung und Standards, die das Netz für alle nachvollziehbar machen

Zur Einordnung: Security-Monitoring und SIEM betreibt ein externer Partner, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Clients, Server und Anwendungen betreuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im IT-Team. Ihr Schwerpunkt ist das Netzwerk selbst, von der Verkabelung bis zum Routing.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Netzwerkadministrator oder Network Engineer, idealerweise inhouse in einem Industrie- oder Produktionsunternehmen

• Sie haben Netze konzipiert, strukturiert und dokumentiert, gern auch als Allrounder mit klarem Netzwerkschwerpunkt in einem kleineren Unternehmen.

• Fundiertes Know-how in Routing und Switching sowie Erfahrung mit der Vernetzung mehrerer Standorte, idealerweise international

• Praxis mit Fortinet oder vergleichbaren Enterprise-Lösungen, etwa Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco oder Sophos

• Erfahrung mit Produktionsnetzen und der Trennung von IT und OT

• Sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit den Standorten

• Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Cisco CCNA/CCNP oder vergleichbar

Das erwartet Sie

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Hersteller-Zertifizierungen

Gehalt

75.000–85.000 € brutto im Jahr plus Tantieme, je nach Erfahrung

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

At Ananda Impact Ventures, we’re not just investors; we’re pioneers and innovators in the impact investment landscape across Europe. In this role, you will work closely with the whole team to identify opportunities for technological improvement, translate operational requirements into technical solutions and take responsibility for their implementation.

The position combines software development, AI engineering, systems integration and process optimisation. It requires a practical approach to technology, an understanding of business requirements and the ability to independently manage technical projects from concept to deployment.

You will have the opportunity to shape Ananda's internal technology infrastructure, establish scalable solutions and assume increasing responsibility as our AI and automation capabilities develop.

Responsibilities: 

  • Investment processes: Develop and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve the identification, evaluation and execution of investment opportunities.

  • Technology development and adoption: Evaluate emerging technologies, identify relevant applications and support their effective integration into existing processes.


Technical Skills:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including practical experience with Python, APIs, databases and modern development tools.

  • Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using large language models, AI agents and related technologies.

  • Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating different software systems and data sources.

  • Understanding of software architecture, data processing, deployment and the development of reliable, maintainable applications.

  • Familiarity with information security, access management and the responsible handling of confidential data.

  • Practical experience: Demonstrated ability to independently develop and implement software applications or automation solutions.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills: Strong ability to understand business processes, identify opportunities for improvement and develop appropriate technical solutions.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: Interest in emerging technologies, startups, venture capital and impact investing.

Over Verzuimdata

Verzuimdata is een gespecialiseerde dienstverlener in het uitwisselen van verzuim-, loon- en werknemersgegevens tussen werkgevers, verzekeraars, arbodiensten en de overheid. Naast standaard dienstverlening leveren wij oplossingen ter ondersteuning van de dagelijkse processen van verzekeraars, volmachten en intermediairs, waaronder polisbeheer, premie- en schadeberekening, schadelastbeheersing, diverse dashboards en een digitale documentenkluis.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Power BI Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van datagedreven oplossingen binnen ons team in Ridderkerk. Je werkt aan heldere dashboards en rapportages die onze processen op het gebied van gegevensuitwisseling inzichtelijk maken.

Wat we vragen

  • Ervaring met Power BI en het bouwen van dashboards

  • Affiniteit met data-analyse en business intelligence

  • Zelfstandige en nauwkeurige werkhouding

Wat we bieden

  • Je werkt op basis van een vast contract van 40 uur per week met een proeftijd van 1 maand.

  • Je ontvangt 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.

  • Er is een bedrijfspensioenregeling aanwezig.

  • Je krijgt de beschikking over een laptop van de zaak en thuiswerkuitrusting.

  • Profiteer van flexibele werktijden, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en een openbaarvervoervergoeding.

  • Het kantoor in Ridderkerk beschikt over barrièrevrije toegang en gratis parkeergelegenheid.

  • Geniet op locatie van gratis drankjes en maak gebruik van de aanwezige cafetaria.

Salaris

Het salaris bedraagt EUR 3,000–3,500 per maand.

Jouw eerste maanden bij Verzuimdata

In je eerste maanden maak je kennis met onze datastromen en systemen, en ga je direct aan de slag met het ontwerpen van overzichtelijke dashboards voor onze gebruikers. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's om gegevensstromen optimaal te vertalen naar waardevolle inzichten. Ook als je nog niet op elk vlak aan alle eisen voldoet maar wel de juiste ervaring meebrengt, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE POSITION

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our growing team and help design, and deploy robust AI software solutions for our clients. You will lead and deliver high-impact AI projects in collaboration with renowned clients in the European industry. You will work hands-on with multi-modal datasets, build predictive models, and develop AI-driven products to support operations and gain efficiencies across business units. Your role will combine hands-on technical exposure with scientific curiosity and business relevance: from extracting insights from client interactions to building robust AI architectures which incorporate state-of-art technology and best practices to deliver client solutions. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to help shape the future of our company and drive innovation.

ABOUT SPHERE ENERGY

We are a young, dynamic and technology-driven company, committed to developing targeted AI-driven solutions that revolutionize the development of products in the broad field of engineering.

Tasks

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop scalable AI-driven software solutions and design end-to-end systems that integrate seamlessly with enterprise data and cloud infrastructure.
  • Establish MLOps standards and reusable pipelines, ensuring clean, maintainable code for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical blueprints, bridging the gap between data science exploration and production engineering.
  • Advise stakeholders on technical strategy, clearly communicating architectural tradeoffs regarding cost, latency, and performance.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with experience in designing enterprise-scale AI solutions.
  • Deep architectural expertise across multiple AI domains—specifically within Generative AI, Computer Vision, and complex predictive modeling.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), with a strong command of software design patterns, microservices architecture, and API design.
  • Expertise in designing robust MLOps ecosystems, including defining standards for CI/CD, model governance, security compliance, and infrastructure orchestration on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Ability to define and execute technical roadmaps paired with the experience mentoring engineering teams, conducting code/design reviews, and enforcing engineering excellence.
  • Expert at balancing critical architectural tradeoffs, including inference latency, scalability, data privacy, and total cost of ownership.

Benefits

WHAT WE OFFER

  • The opportunity to drive leading technology solutions in real-world applications
  • A high-impact, client-facing role with real responsibility and room for initiative
  • A collaborative and dynamic work environment that values vision and impact
  • Opportunity to actively contribute to a young company’s growth
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work models

HOW TO APPLY

If you’re excited to shape the future of battery technology and drive real change with leading industry players, please share your resume and an additional cover letter.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
talenthafen steht für Exzellenz im modernen Recruiting.
Wir sind eine strategische Beratung und ein Systemhaus für Arbeitgeberpositionierung und Personalgewinnung – mit technologischer Tiefe, klaren Systemen und operativer Umsetzungskraft.
Im DACH-Raum zählen wir zu den führenden Unternehmen in unserem Segment. Mittelständische und große Organisationen wie die Voets Gruppe, Westfalen und die Nord-Ostsee Sparkasse vertrauen auf unsere Expertise, wenn es darum geht, sich nachhaltig als relevanter und zukunftsfähiger Arbeitgeber zu positionieren.

Unser Anspruch ist es nicht, dem Markt zu folgen – sondern ihn aktiv mitzugestalten.

talenthafen ist Vorreiter in der Innovation des Recruitings.
Wir leben Fortschritt. Wir entwickeln eigene Systeme, implementieren Automatisierungen und integrieren künstliche Intelligenzen konsequent in unsere internen Prozesse und Kundenstrukturen. Dadurch schaffen wir skalierbare, messbare und nachhaltige Lösungen – und setzen neue Standards in der Branche.

Hinter diesem Anspruch steht ein starkes Fundament:
Ein Team von über 60 ambitionierten Persönlichkeiten, die unternehmerisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln wollen. Auf mehr als 900 m² Bürofläche in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld entsteht täglich die nächste Stufe moderner Personalgewinnung - sowohl menschlich als auch technisch.

Was uns besonders macht, ist nicht nur unsere Marktposition und Software, sondern die Qualität unseres Teams.

Wir arbeiten leistungsorientiert, professionell und mit klaren Standards. Hohe Ansprüche treffen bei uns auf hohe Wertschätzung: überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, echte Entwicklungsperspektiven und ein Umfeld, in dem Exzellenz gefördert wird.

talenthafen ist kein klassisches Recruiting-Unternehmen. Wir kombinieren Performance Marketing mit unserer eigenen Tech-Plattform talenthafenOS – über 70 automatisierte Workflows, die den HR-Markt neu definieren. Bootstrapped, profitabel, dreistelliges Wachstum. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Beratung und Technologie, in einem Markt, der gerade komplett umgebaut wird.

Deine Rolle: Recruiting-Kampagnen mit talenthafenOS aufsetzen, betreuen und optimieren. Du kümmerst dich um das, was am Ende über den Erfolg entscheidet – die Performance.

Aufgaben

Dein Daily Business

  • Volle Ownership für deine Kundenaccounts. Du steuerst Paid-Kampagnen auf Meta, Google & Co. für unsere Top-B2B-Kunden – von Zielgruppe über Funnel bis Skalierung. Der Erfolg der Kampagne ist deine Verantwortung, nicht die von „dem Team"

  • Proaktives Performance-Management. Du wartest nicht auf Reports oder Anweisungen – du erkennst, wenn eine Kampagne aus dem Ruder läuft, bevor sie zum Problem wird, und steuerst gegen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen Abteilungen. Die Strategieberater halten den Kundenkontakt und geben dir den nötigen Kontext – du übersetzt ihn in Kampagnen, die liefern. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen, gemeinsame Verantwortung fürs Ergebnis

  • Kanalübergreifendes Creative- und Zielgruppen-Denken. Du denkst nicht in Plattform-Silos, sondern in Zielgruppen, Botschaften und Hooks – und verstehst, wie Creative, Targeting und Daten zusammenspielen

  • Reindenken in Kunden. Jeder Kunde hat einen eigenen Markt, eigene Zielgruppen, eigene Engpässe. Du verstehst das Geschäft deiner Kunden so gut, dass deine Kampagnen-Entscheidungen strategisch begründet sind – nicht nur technisch

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Du hinterfragst laufende Setups: Welcher Kanal, welches Creative, welcher Funnel-Schritt hat noch Luft? Stillstand ist keine Option

  • KI als Hebel, nicht als Buzzword. Du nutzt unsere Plattform und moderne AI-Tools, um Recherche, Creative-Testing und Optimierung auf ein Niveau zu heben, das manuell nicht erreichbar ist – und bringst eigene Ideen mit, wie es noch besser geht

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen:

  • Erfahrung mit Paid-Kampagnen. Du hast Kampagnen schon eigenständig geplant und betreut und kennst Kampagnenstrukturen, Creative-Testing sowie die wichtigsten Bid- und Attributionslogiken
  • Datenkompetenz. Zahlen sind für dich die Grundlage jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht. Du weißt, welche KPI wann zählt
  • Eigenantrieb und Verbindlichkeit. Du brauchst niemanden, der dich anschiebt oder erinnert. Was du übernimmst, wird erledigt – in Qualität und im Zeitrahmen
  • Ein unternehmerisches Mindset. Du denkst in Hebeln und nächsten Schritten, holst dir aktiv Inspiration – aus Werbebibliotheken, anderen Märkten, neuen Formaten – und denkst über den Tellerrand deines Aufgabenzettels hinaus
  • Neugier. Du hast Lust, mit einer eigenen Software-Plattform zu arbeiten, Neues auszuprobieren und dazuzulernen

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

  • Eine eigene Recruiting-Plattform (talenthafenOS) statt Tools von der Stange

  • Eigenfinanziert, profitabel und stark wachsend

  • Spannende Kunden quer durch den DACH-Mittelstand

  • Gutes Gehalt und ein klarer Karriereplan

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team, in dem Feedback und Weiterentwicklung wirklich gelebt werden

  • Modernes Office in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld – kreativ & professionell zugleich

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung & ehrliches Mentoring

  • Offene Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege

Das bekommst du on top

  • 500€ Gesundheitsbudget oder Zuschuss zum Wellpass
  • 50€ monatlich für deine Altersvorsorge
  • MacBook – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Regelmäßige Grill- & Teamabende (alle 3 Monate)
  • Raum, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

..und alles, was halt dazu gehört (Obstkorb & Co)

Klingt nach dem nächsten Schritt für dich?

Bring gemeinsam mit talenthafen den Recruiting-Markt aufs nächste Level - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung (CV reicht – kein Anschreiben nötig)

  2. Telefonisches Erstgespräch (ca. 20 Minuten)

  3. Video-Interview mit Fachbereich

  4. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Hamburg

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent - dentolo (all genders)

  • Kundenbetreuung: Als Erstkontakt stehst du unseren Kund:innen bei Fragen zur Seite. Mit deiner Produktexpertise hilfst du Bestandskund:innen ihre Bedürfnisse und Anfragen zu ihren Zahnzusatztarifen zu beantworten.

  • Wissensmanagement: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Wissensdatenbank.

  • Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung: Du leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung und Optimierung unserer Prozesse und der Customer Journey im Bereich Customer Success.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im Kundensupport: Du hast bereits Erfahrungen im Kundenservice oder ähnlichen Bereichen mit Kundenkontakt gesammelt.
  • Organisationstalent und Teamwork: Du verfügst über organisatorische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Dein Teamgeist, gepaart mit deiner Flexibilität, machen dich zu einer wertvollen Bereicherung. Du bringst nicht nur Aufgeschlossenheit und Motivation mit, sondern zeigst den Willen, aktiv an der Gestaltung eines dynamischen Unternehmens mitzuwirken.
  • Zahnmedizinische Vorkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse in MS Office: Idealerweise besitzt du das Know-how für die MS Office-Anwendungen.
  • Sprachkompetenz im Arbeitsumfeld: Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift. Zusätzlich besitzt du fließende Englischkenntnisse.

Warum getolo?

🌴 Gehalt & Urlaub

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt
  • Gestaffelte Urlaubstage, beginnend bei 28 Tagen (max. 30 Tage). Frei am 24. und 31.12

🧑‍💻 Mobilität & Flexibilität

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem kostenlosen Swapfiets-Fahrrad oder einem von uns bezuschussten BVG oder Deutschlandticket
  • Arbeite hybrid - aus deinem Home Office oder in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte
  • Arbeite bis zu 60 Tage im EU-Ausland

🧘 Gesundheit

  • Nutzung von kostenlosen Coaching-Sitzungen mit nilo.health, unserem Tool für mentale Gesundheit
  • Teste unsere Produkte selbst! Wähle zwischen dentolo, petolo oder vitolo

📚 Weiterentwicklung

  • Weiterbildungs­budget ab 750 € jährlich
  • Regelmäßiges (360 Grad) Feedback

🌍 In Berlin ansässig, mit internationaler Denkweise

  • Wir kommunizieren, arbeiten zusammen und feiern auf Englisch, um sicherzustellen, dass alle einbezogen werden.
  • Unser diverses Team kommt aus 43 verschiedenen Ländern.

🧬 Werte

  • Unsere Werte sind keine Schlagworte, sondern Taten, die Teil unserer individuellen und kollektiven DNA sind:
  • #fast: Wir vereinfachen Dinge, handeln mit Dringlichkeit und konzentrieren uns auf Ergebnisse.
  • #brave: Wir treffen mutige Entscheidungen, hinterfragen den Status Quo und handeln aus Überzeugung.
  • #accountable: Wir liefern Ergebnisse von Anfang bis Ende, reduzieren Abhängigkeiten und stehen zu unseren Entscheidungen.
  • #caring: Wir behandeln einander mit Respekt, bauen Vertrauen auf und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem jeder über sich hinauswachsen kann.

🙌 Teamgeist

  • Legendäre Sommer- und Winterpartys
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Mitarbeitervergünstigungen über Corporate Benefits
  • Zwei Ehrenamtstage pro Kalenderjahr
  • Haustierfreundliches Büro

Klingt nach einer perfekten Stelle für dich?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Über getolo

Die 2015 gegründete getolo GmbH ist ein innovatives und mehrfach ausgezeichnetes InsurTech, das ganzheitliche Zusatztarife in den Bereichen Zahnzusatz, Tierkranken und -haftpflicht sowie Krankenzusatztarife anbietet. Unter den Marken dentolo, petolo und vitolo betreuen wir über 265.000 Kund:innen in Deutschland und bieten einen digitalen und unkomplizierten Schutz an, der sich nahtlos in den Alltag unserer Kund:innen integriert.
Wir glauben: Vorsorge ist immer besser als Nachsorge und deshalb stellen wir Prävention, kundenzentrierten Service und finanzielle Sicherheit in den Mittelpunkt, um Kund:innen und ihre Liebsten vor unerwarteten Kosten zu schützen. Dank der engen Zusammenarbeit unseres Teams aus Marktspezialist:innen und Versicherungsexpert:innen behalten wir aktuelle Entwicklungen stets im Blick, um praktikable Lösungen für aktuelle Probleme anzubieten.
Die getolo Unternehmenskultur basiert auf Zusammenarbeit, Innovationsgeist und Schnelligkeit – immer mit dem klaren Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen. Mit einem Team von rund 300 Mitarbeitenden wird getolo von Daniel Gadea (CEO) und Laura Wulff (CGO) geleitet. getolo ist Partner von DA Direkt und Teil der Zurich Gruppe Deutschland.

getolo ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. Wir bemühen uns, ein freundliches, sicheres und einladendes Umfeld für alle getolis zu schaffen, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen und Begabungen jeglicher Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialem Hintergrund, Familienstand, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Fehlen).

Bei deiner Bewerbung konzentrieren wir uns ausschließlich auf deine Erfahrung und Motivation. Du entscheidest selbst, welche zusätzlichen Informationen du preisgeben möchtest (Foto, Familienstand, Religion, Geschlecht, Nationalität usw.). Wir schätzen und behandeln alle Bewerbungen gleich.

Gesucht wird dabei ausdrücklich kein rein administrativer Team Lead. Du solltest aus dem Outbound Sales kommen, erfolgreiche Vertriebsansätze selbst angewendet haben und in der Lage sein, diese Erfahrung sehr praxisnah an dein Team weiterzugeben.

Deine Aufgabe

Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Teams von Business Development Representatives und entwickelst dieses zu einer leistungsstarken Outbound-Organisation weiter.

  • Customer Focus: Du stellst sicher, dass das Team trotz hoher Outbound-Aktivität einen professionellen, beratenden und kundenorientierten Vertriebsansatz verfolgt.

Wir suchen eine Person mit einem starken operativen Sales-Background und erster bzw. fundierter Führungserfahrung in einem ambitionierten B2B-Vertriebsumfeld.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Business Development / Sales Development / Outbound Sales

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbar dynamischen Geschäftsmodell

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, Coaching oder in der Führung von SDR-/BDR-Teams

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Was die Rolle besonders macht

Die Position bietet deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum als eine klassische Team-Lead-Rolle.

Du übernimmst ein Team in einer wichtigen Wachstumsphase und kannst unmittelbar beeinflussen, wie Outbound Sales organisiert, gesteuert und weiterentwickelt wird. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Management und der kommerziellen Führung des Unternehmens zusammen.

Die Rolle eignet sich besonders für jemanden, der weiterhin nah am operativen Vertrieb bleiben möchte und Spaß daran hat, ein Team nicht nur zu managen, sondern durch Coaching, Struktur und eigene Sales-Erfahrung messbar besser zu machen.

Unser Mandant ist ein wachstumsstarkes europäisches Technologieunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin. Das Unternehmen bietet eine B2B-Softwarelösung für mittelständische Unternehmen und hat sich in den vergangenen Jahren erfolgreich in mehreren europäischen Märkten etabliert.

Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team.

You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing.

There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month.

The role

As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them.

You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers.

The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need.

Live project examples:

  • Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer.

  • No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay.

  • Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments.

  • Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists.

  • Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind.

  • Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React.

  • Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code.

  • Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next.

  • Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it.

  • Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building a legal transformation practice for the AI era. Our Transformation Office brings together highly experienced consultants and practitioners to help law firms and legal departments turn AI from a tool their teams use into value their business can see.

Harvey’s experts help leaders decide what to change, and how to change it, as they adopt and embed new ways of working: how legal work is organized and governed, how it’s priced by firms and valued by in-house teams and how their people build new capability. The Transformation Office then works alongside their teams to make it happen. Our advice draws on what we see across Harvey's customers in more than 50 countries and on where the technology is heading. Our client work shapes Harvey's product, and the product shapes our advice. Both improve together.

Law firms and legal departments are making decisions now that will shape how they compete for the next decade: which work to prioritize, how to price and value it, how to staff it and how to organize around AI. As Transformation Advisory Lead for Strategy & Economics, you help their leaders make those decisions well. You have made them yourself, inside a firm or a legal department, and advised others through them, so managing partners, general counsel and CFOs treat you as a peer.

You will be one of the first senior specialists in Harvey's Transformation Office. You will help build our strategy and economics offering, bring that expertise to client engagements run by our Engagement Managers and join our Practice Directors when a customer has a specific need in strategy and economics. What you learn will shape how Harvey advises the market and what we build next.

What You'll Do

  • Advise on strategy. Help leaders decide where AI changes their competitive position: which practices/domains, clients and types of work to prioritize, and where to invest.

  • Advise on pricing and value. Help firms and legal departments measure the impact of AI on the cost, speed and value of their work. For firms, that means working through how fee structures and value models need to change; for legal departments, it means showing the value their work creates for the business.

  • Advise on operating models. Help customers redesign how legal work is organized, supported and staffed, including team structures and the roles AI creates or changes.

  • Help leaders make the case for change. Work with managing partners, general counsel and finance leaders to build the case they take to their partnership, board, internal stakeholders or executive team.

  • Build the offering. Create the diagnostics, frameworks and leadership readouts the Transformation Office uses to deliver strategy and economics engagements, and turn each engagement into material the wider team can use.

Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing.

Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

  • Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

  • Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.

  • Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.

Du passt, wenn du

  • 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

  • Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

  • Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

  • Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Deine Benefits

  • Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

  • Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

  • Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate

  • Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

  • Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

  • Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements
 

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred 

  • Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs 

  • Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

  • Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex 

  • Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry 

  • Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies

  • SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne 

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation 

  • Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment 

  • Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases 

  • Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar 

  • Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments 

  • Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response 

  • Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations 

  • General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics

  • Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

    (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

  • Hours are full-time: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm. There is no on-call requirement for this position.

Why would you choose to come and work with us?

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

Nomios offers a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and industry-leading benefits, along with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we and our customers build and run Security Operations.

Nomios is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating and sustaining an environment in which everyone is provided with an equal opportunity to grow and develop, and no individual will be unjustly discriminated against. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion and belief, sex and sexual orientation.

Department: Data team

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

  • Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

  • Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

  • Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

  • Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it.

  • Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

  • Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems.

  • Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better.

  • Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself.

  • You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple.

  • You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both.

  • You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better.

  • Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference.

  • We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real.

  • Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most.

  • The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers.

  • Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without.

WHY CARWOW?

  • Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers

  • An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available

  • A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously

jobs.title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

 

  • Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics. You will partner with our Data Science team to architect the runtime infrastructure that serves predictive models and machine learning algorithms directly within our sub-millisecond real-time ad targeting engine.

  • Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

  • Plus: Cloud Resilience & Tooling: Hands-on experience with continuous profiling (e.g., Pyroscope, goroutine dumps), chaos engineering drills, and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, or AWS cloud networking.
    ‌

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

 

What’s in It for You?

 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re shaping the architectural foundation behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems and patterns you design will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Unterstütze uns dabei, das Versicherungserlebnis der Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten!

Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewinnung von Top-Talenten, während sich getolo vom Start-up zum Scale-up weiterentwickelt. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für unsere Sales- und Operations-Teams.

Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche) und im hybriden Arbeitsmodell zu besetzen. Du arbeitest 1–2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro. Voraussetzung sind verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Deine Mission

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der Kandidatensuche über die Vorauswahl und Interviews bis hin zur Einstellung.
  • Du entwickelst und implementierst effektive Recruiting-Strategien, um Top-Talente zu gewinnen und einen vielfältigen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Hiring Managern zusammen, um ihren Personalbedarf zu verstehen, begleitest sie beratend und unterstützend durch den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess.
  • Du steuerst den Recruiting-Prozess, einschließlich der Veröffentlichung von Stellenanzeigen, der Prüfung von Bewerbungsunterlagen, der Durchführung von Interviews und der Erstellung von Jobangeboten.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle relevanten Gesetze und Compliance im Recruiting eingehalten werden.
  • Du pflegst die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Personalvermittlungen und anderen Recruiting-Kanälen.
  • Du unterstützt Employer-Branding-Initiativen, um getolo als attraktiven Arbeitgeber zu positionieren.
  • Du behältst aktuelle Trends und Best Practices im Talent Acquisition im Blick und bringst neue Ideen ein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Talent Acquisition oder Recruiting
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Suche und Einstellung von Top-Talenten
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse gängiger Recruiting-Methoden und -Tools
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und ein gutes Gespür im Umgang mit Menschen
  • Die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen
  • Erfahrung in einem dynamischen, schnelllebigen Arbeitsumfeld
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Recruiting-Software und anderen HR-Tools
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau)

Damit kannst du uns zusätzlich überzeugen

  • Erfahrung im Recruiting für Sales, Operations oder im Insurtech-Bereich
  • Erfahrung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up
  • Erfahrung im Recruiting für Positionen mit hohem Einstellungsbedarf
  • Erfahrung im Einsatz von Recruiting-Daten zur Analyse und Optimierung von Einstellungsprozessen

Benefits

Warum getolo?

🌴 Gehalt & Urlaub

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt
  • Gestaffelte Urlaubstage, beginnend bei 28 Tagen (max. 30 Tage). Frei am 24. und 31.12.

🧑‍💻 Mobilität & Flexibilität

  • Wähle zwischen einem Swapfiets-Fahrrad oder einem Berlin/Brandenburg-Ticket („VBB-Jobticket“) oder einem von uns bezuschussten BVG ‘'Deutschlandticket’'
  • Arbeite hybrid - aus deinem Home Office oder in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte
  • Arbeite bis zu 60 Tage im EU-Ausland

🧘 Gesundheit

  • Nutzung von kostenlosen Coaching-Sitzungen mit nilo.health, unserem Tool für mentale Gesundheit
  • Teste unsere Produkte selbst! Wähle zwischen dentolo, petolo oder vitolo

📚 Weiterentwicklung

  • Weiterbildungs­budget ab 750 € jährlich
  • Regelmäßiges (360 Grad) Feedback

🌍 In Berlin ansässig, mit internationaler Denkweise

  • Wir kommunizieren, arbeiten zusammen und feiern auf Englisch, um sicherzustellen, dass alle einbezogen werden
  • Unser diverses Team kommt aus 33 verschiedenen Ländern

🧬 Werte 

Unsere Werte sind keine Schlagworte, sondern Taten, die Teil unserer individuellen und kollektiven DNA sind:

    • #fast: Wir vereinfachen Dinge, handeln mit Dringlichkeit und konzentrieren uns auf Ergebnisse
    • #brave: Wir treffen mutige Entscheidungen, hinterfragen den Status Quo und handeln aus Überzeugung
    • #accountable: Wir liefern Ergebnisse von Anfang bis Ende, reduzieren Abhängigkeiten und stehen zu unseren Entscheidungen
    • #caring: Wir behandeln einander mit Respekt, bauen Vertrauen auf und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem jeder über sich hinauswachsen kann

🙌 Und vieles mehr…

  • Legendäre Sommer- und Winter­partys 
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Mitarbeitervergünstigungen über Corporate Benefits
  • Zwei Ehrenamtstage pro Kalenderjahr
  • Haustierfreundliches Büro

Klingt nach einer perfekten Stelle für dich?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Über getolo

Die 2015 gegründete getolo GmbH ist ein innovatives und mehrfach ausgezeichnetes InsurTech, das ganzheitliche Zusatztarife in den Bereichen Zahnzusatz, Tierkranken und -haftpflicht sowie Krankenzusatztarife anbietet. Unter den Marken dentolo, petolo, patolo und vitolo betreuen wir über 265.000 Kund:innen in Deutschland, Frankreich und Spanien. Wir bieten einen digitalen und unkomplizierten Schutz an, der sich nahtlos in den Alltag unserer Kund:innen integriert.
Wir glauben: Vorsorge ist immer besser als Nachsorge und deshalb stellen wir Prävention, kundenzentrierten Service und finanzielle Sicherheit in den Mittelpunkt, um Kund:innen und ihre Liebsten vor unerwarteten Kosten zu schützen. Dank der engen Zusammenarbeit unseres Teams aus Marktspezialist:innen und Versicherungsexpert:innen behalten wir aktuelle Entwicklungen stets im Blick, um praktikable Lösungen für aktuelle Probleme anzubieten.
Die getolo Unternehmenskultur basiert auf Zusammenarbeit, Innovationsgeist und Schnelligkeit – immer mit dem klaren Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen. Mit einem Team von rund 300 Mitarbeitenden wird getolo von Daniel Gadea (CEO) und Laura Wulff (CGO) geleitet. getolo ist Partner von DA Direkt und Teil der Zurich Gruppe Deutschland.

getolo ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. Wir bemühen uns, ein freundliches, sicheres und einladendes Umfeld für alle getolis zu schaffen, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen und Begabungen jeglicher Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialem Hintergrund, Familienstand, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Fehlen).

Bei deiner Bewerbung konzentrieren wir uns ausschließlich auf deine Erfahrung und Motivation. Du entscheidest selbst, welche zusätzlichen Informationen du preisgeben möchtest (Foto, Familienstand, Religion, Geschlecht, Nationalität usw.). Wir schätzen und behandeln alle Bewerbungen gleich.

Au quotidien

  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et documenter l’existant

Votre profil

What You’ll Do

  • Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents.

  • Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

Final Compensation

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

jobs.title: Real Estate Transaction Lead, Central
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets.

Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade.

The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across Central markets including Texas, Chicago, the Midwest, Nashville, and Denver. Markets are TBD and could extend west or east depending on demand.

• Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the Central region.

• LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution.

• Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny.

• Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the Central region.

• Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards.

• Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout.

• Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales.

Minimum Qualifications

• 3 to 7 years of real estate transaction experience, with meaningful time spent in-house at a healthcare, wellness, or high-growth retail company.

• You have personally led deals end to end, from site identification through LOI to signed lease, in competitive markets.

• Comfort working in a startup environment with real pressure, fast timelines, and limited infrastructure. You build as you go.

• A self-starter who does not need a fully defined playbook to do great work.

• Strong communication skills. You can represent Neko professionally with institutional landlords while keeping internal stakeholders informed concisely.

• Ability to read and pressure-test lease terms, rent schedules, and deal economics. You do not need to build financial models from scratch, but you need to know when a deal works and when it does not.

• Familiarity with GIS tools and lease administration platforms is a plus; willingness to learn them quickly is a must.

• AI: We use AI tools including Claude in daily work and expect you to use them too.

• Based in the Central United States. You should be within reasonable travel of the markets you cover.

Compensation: $157.5K – $192.5K

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration.
